newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian bonds end year firm amid slim interest.
newsitem.headline: Austrian bonds end year firm amid slim interest.

text.p: 1600 GMT - Austrian bonds drifted higher on Monday, the last day of trading in the year, and traders predicted the market would start the new year on a buoyant note.
* Latest 10 year benchmark 5.875 pct bond maturing July 2006 up five bps at 100.25 to yield 5.83 (5.84) pct in bourse trade, quoted post-market at 100.22/30 to yield 5.84/5.83.
* At the near end, five-year 5.50 percent bond maturing March 2001 up 10 bps at 103.40 to yield 4.64 (4.66) percent in bourse trade, quoted post-market at 103.34/103.42 to yield 4.65/63 percent.
* AGB future up 22 bps at 106.86 on turnover of 251 lots.
* 10-year spread to German bunds up one at seven bps, five-year spread up one at 15 bps.
* Money market rates mixed with three-month VIBOR steady at 3.350 and overnight money just higher at 3.19/3.44. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 53112 257
